title.narrative: Mapping of Mineral Resources Extraction and Post Management in UNESCO BRs and Geoparks in Africa

description.narrative: Through the project, UNESCO aims to get a better understanding of the mineral exploration practices in and near these UNESCO BR and UGGp in Africa. The African continent heavily relies on mining for its economic revenue. Despite the vast richness of mineral reserves, there have been shortcomings in their development, when considered from the perspective of sustainability. To tackle these challenges, it is crucial to assess site conditions, a task achievable through the engagement with local communities. With about 90 BRs and Geoparks in Africa, UNESCO is uniquely situated to leverage a strong network of learning, living laboratories across the continent. UNESCO will convene relevant stakeholder and embark on a survey of mining practices. Collaborating with scientists and local experts, UNESCO will assess the multifaceted impacts of current practices and support MS to improve their knowledge and capacity.
